name: MediaText
summary: A figure beside a short passage with a heading and actions; they stack when narrow.

guidance.useFor: A case-study highlight or a feature explained with an image: one heading, a paragraph or two, and a link.
insteadUse: The top of the page: Hero (a figure as its object makes the split hero)
A grid of items: Feature grid or Project card
content: Keep the passage short: two paragraphs at most
Alternate the figure's side down a page by source order, not by CSS

rungReason: A <section> named by its heading; grid with auto-fit stacks the columns with no queries.

props.title: the heading
props.mediaPosition: start (default) or end, in source order

rules: Visual order is source order: the figure's side follows the markup (WCAG 1.3.2)
Stacks when either column would be narrower than 26rem (WCAG 1.4.10)
